title: Sharp Bounds for Two-Decision Treatment Regimes under Second-Moment Confounding Budgets
banked_reason: The nuisance-indexed operator F^{tilde beta} is never constructed, so its Frechet derivative and uniform modulus are not determinate objects; the D-0.5 revision cap was exhausted.
gap_reasons: The nuisance-indexed operator \(\mathcal F^{\widetilde\beta}\) is never constructed: the core does not specify which entries of the heterogeneous \(\widetilde\beta\) replace which arguments of \(\mathcal F\), so its Frechet derivative and uniform modulus are not determinate objects.
Its condition quantifies over \(\mathcal B_\beta(\delta)\), but the only declared localized set is \(\mathcal B_\beta^+(\delta)\); use one declared positivity-preserving domain consistently.

Once the regular-ray simultaneous band is granted, membership of \(g_P\) in the class defining \(C_b\) and hence \(\kappa_b^\star\in C_b\) is exactly the containment observation built into def:full-ray-inversion; demote it to a corollary or add a non-definitional statistical contribution.
proof_attempt_summary: Five D-0.5 revisions developed the two-decision transported-perspective sharpness proposal, conditional projection, endpoint attainment, and a clipped-affine two-price dual. The inference spine collapsed because the final core still did not construct its nuisance-perturbed root operator or a coherent positivity-preserving derivative domain; its advertised full-ray result also remained deterministic containment rather than a separate theorem. A future attempt must define that operator and prove its orthogonality/remainder theory before making uniform-in-budget inference claims, while incorporating the Jin--Ren--Zhou f-sensitivity comparator.
tldr: Worst-case propensity-ratio caps can be driven by rare histories, while a second-moment budget measures average confounding strength. For the fixed two-decision regime \((1,1)\), the compatible mean set is characterized as an exact compact interval generated by a convex perspective program. A conditional projection defines the observed-law ratio \(h_0^{\mathrm{pr}}\) separately from the original full-law ratio \(h_0\), restores the required early-history factorization, and supports compatible laws attaining the endpoints. The two-global-price dual uses a joint conditional normalization system and handles active, zero-price, and unit-budget faces through clipped-affine quadratic-perspective geometry. The statistical frontier is an explicit cross-fitted optimized-value score with propensity learners clipped away from zero and one and with two indispensable propensity-floor corrections. Resolving local existence and stability of nuisance-perturbed joint roots, price perturbations, Neyman orthogonality, and the second-order \(L^2(P)\) remainder yields a joint multiplier band whose deterministic range extension remains honest at tied, flat, or absent breakdown crossings.
gap: Zhang and Zhao's Proposition 3, Theorem 1, and Section 4.4 treat a one-treatment second-moment model, whereas Tan treats sequential compatibility under range-bounded ratios; neither covers the two-decision transported-perspective model and its coupled inference problem.
fill: The project derives exact compatible sharpness, attainment, boundary-correct duality, and a falsifiable route to uniform endpoint and breakdown-region inference under primitive learner and clipping conditions.
